summary: Reproduced that an explicit speculative draft load format of auto remained LoadFormat.AUTO for an S3 draft and selected DefaultModelLoader. Updated draft object-storage format resolution to treat explicit auto like the existing unspecified case, producing LoadFormat.RUNAI_STREAMER and RunaiModelStreamerLoader without mutating the target load-format field.

tests.what_was_measured: Failing-before regression with the original condition: target resolved to runai_streamer but the explicit draft value remained auto.
26 focused tests passed after the fix, including concrete RunaiModelStreamerLoader selection and independent unspecified, explicit non-auto, non-object-store, and per-runner isolation boundaries.
Before: target=runai_streamer, draft=auto, LoadFormat.AUTO, DefaultModelLoader. After: target=runai_streamer, draft=runai_streamer, LoadFormat.RUNAI_STREAMER, RunaiModelStreamerLoader.

remaining_limitations: No real S3-compatible object store or model weights were available, so object download and full server startup were not exercised.
No H20 multi-node TP=8/PP=2 deployment reproduction was attempted; the verified behavior is the pre-hardware loader-selection path described by the issue.

The assigned gfx950 GPU was not used because this defect occurs before GPU execution and a GPU smoke would not validate object-storage loader selection; the CPU-only loader-dispatch output is retained in evidence.txt.
